name: voice
label: Voice
tagline: Speech in and out for all of Forge

manifest.summary: The only Forge process that loads speech models. Speech-to-text (whisper.cpp) and text-to-speech (Kokoro) from shared/voice_registry.json, loaded on first use and unloaded when idle; push-to-talk from the Super+Z hotkey that sends what you say to Acchan (Jan) or Claude and speaks the reply; an HTTP API the other apps use for listening and speaking.

features.name: Registry
features.description: Models are rows in shared/voice_registry.json; engines are one file each in engines/ found by the row's engine field.

features.name: Push-to-talk
features.description: Hold to talk while held, or tap to talk until a pause or the next tap. A tap while speaking hushes.

features.name: Routing
features.description: A leading wake name picks Claude or Jan; stop, cancel and say that again are handled here.

features.name: Per-app picks
features.description: Each app with a voice field in its forge_app.json gets its own model, voice, speed and speak-replies setting.

known_gaps: No model download or delete routes yet
